stories.title: Sam Altman warns against a future where AI, not humans, calls the shots
stories.take: Altman and Brockman push back on AI-takeover talk while admitting keeping advanced models under human control is getting harder.

stories.title: Waymo has stopped its robotaxis from driving on the freeway—here’s why
stories.take: Waymo pulled its robotaxis off freeways after earlier recalls for entering highway construction zones — a safety pause, not a retreat.

stories.title: Criminals Have a New Favorite ‘Point-and-Shoot’ AI Hacking Tool
stories.take: Artex and similar tools let novice hackers scan and attack systems with chatbot prompts — penetration-testing power, now point-and-shoot for criminals.

stories.title: Tesla’s $30,000 Cybercab comes with a $299 monthly catch
stories.take: The $30,000 Cybercab comes with a $299-a-month catch, plus Tesla limits on where it can drive and whether owners can resell it.

stories.title: Nvidia clarifies when it will — and won’t — keep financing neoclouds
stories.take: Nvidia says it backstops a neocloud loan only if the facility gets built with independent financing and its gear installed.

stories.title: The AI Hype Index: AI is everywhere
stories.take: MIT's index finds AI everywhere — even as Google's AI Overviews cost it billions in lost ad revenue.

stories.title: Voyager 1 at one light-day: Historian revisits Golden Record's forgotten details
stories.take: Voyager 1 is now a full light-day away; a historian revisits the Golden Record's forgotten details as the signal keeps traveling.

stories.title: 7 Ways Rockstar Is Bringing GTA 6’s Vice City to Life in the Real World
stories.take: Rockstar is taking over iconic Miami spots and beyond to bring Vice City into the real world for the GTA VI launch.

stories.title: Brands booking creators to make their ads are pushing up $116B global influencer market
stories.take: Brands hiring creators to make the ads themselves are pushing the global influencer market to $116B, growing at double the pace of the rest of advertising.

stories.title: Paid media now plays largest role in brand-funded creator growth: report
stories.take: Paid dollars behind creator content are now nearly half of brand-funded creator growth — well ahead of the traditional sponsored post.

stories.title: Artists and creators are leaving Etsy in droves over its new AI policy
stories.take: Artists are leaving Etsy in droves over its new AI policy, with goodbye messages flooding social media.

stories.title: Maker’s Mark spotlights signature red wax top in visual refresh
stories.take: Maker's Mark leans into its signature red wax in a visual refresh meant to look modern as bourbon sales slow.

stories.title: Instacart Returns to the Super Bowl for Its Third Straight Year
stories.take: Instacart is back for a third straight Super Bowl — in October DoorDash announced a $17 billion acquisition of the company.

stories.title: Lakers' Grimes makes history after hitting 10 3s in win over Hornets
stories.take: Quentin Grimes hit 10 threes — only the second Laker ever to do it — in a 118-114 win over Charlotte.

stories.title: Re-grading the Giannis Antetokounmpo trade: Why the Heat and Bucks both look much worse now
stories.take: A month in, the Giannis-to-Miami fit looks clunky and the trade looks like an organization-wide debacle for Milwaukee.

stories.title: NBA Power Rankings: One wild stat for all 30 teams
stories.take: One wild stat for all 30 teams, a month into the season — where every team really stands.

stories.title: LeBron sues makers of AI sports-betting app 'Bron,' cites 'willful, bad-faith tactic'
stories.take: LeBron sued the makers of the AI betting app 'Bron,' calling its use of his name and likeness a willful, bad-faith tactic.

stories.title: NBA MVP Rankings: Luka Dončić, Victor Wembanyama in a two-horse race; Stephen Curry's absence speaks volumes
stories.take: Luka Dončić and Victor Wembanyama lead the MVP race in a two-horse battle, ahead of two-time winner Shai Gilgeous-Alexander.

stories.title: MLB CBA negotiations timeline: MLBPA says league has 'wasted months of time' as Dec. 1 deadline nears
stories.take: The players say MLB has 'wasted months of time' as the Dec. 1 CBA deadline nears and a work stoppage looms.

stories.title: Sources: Mets considered Skubal front-runner as teams ramp up pursuit of ace lefty
stories.take: The Mets are considered the front-runner for ace Tarik Skubal as teams ramp up their pursuit.

stories.title: Sources: Royals send Garcia to Mariners for Miller in six-player trade
stories.take: Kansas City sends Gold Glove infielder Maikel Garcia to Seattle for Bryce Miller in a six-player trade.

stories.title: Yankees' Bednar, Twins' Jeffers accept $23.15M qualifying offer to return
stories.take: Yankees closer David Bednar and Twins catcher Ryan Jeffers accept the $23.15M qualifying offer and return for one year.

stories.title: Pitching-needy White Sox, May agree to 3-year, $52.5M contract
stories.take: The pitching-needy White Sox land Dustin May on a 3-year, $52.5M deal after his 7-9, 4.70 ERA season.

stories.title: Posey, Lester among 14 newcomers on baseball's Hall of Fame ballot
stories.take: Buster Posey and Jon Lester headline 14 newcomers on the Hall of Fame ballot, with Chase Utley and Andy Pettitte among the holdovers.

stories.title: Democrats formally nominate Hakeem Jeffries for speaker of the House
stories.take: House Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries for speaker — he would be the first Black lawmaker in U.S. history to hold the gavel.

stories.title: Democrat Mary Peltola wins Alaska Senate seat, beating Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan
stories.take: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat, giving Democrats a 56-44 majority after flipping nine GOP-held seats.

stories.title: House Democrat warns 13 Trump allies to save their records for upcoming investigations
stories.take: Incoming Oversight chair Robert Garcia tells 13 Trump allies — including Trump Jr., Eric Trump and Jared Kushner — to save records for coming investigations.

stories.title: Trump lands in China with key meetings with Xi and Putin on the agenda
stories.take: Trump lands in Shenzhen for APEC, with Xi greeting him on the tarmac and key meetings with Xi and Putin on the agenda.

stories.title: Senators criticize Apple and Google for letting teens access ‘nudify’ apps despite parental controls
stories.take: Three Senate Democrats say Apple and Google safeguards are failing to keep teens from 'nudify' apps despite parental controls.

stories.title: ICE offers firm operating deportation flights windfall and secrecy, data shows
stories.take: ICE agreed to windfall terms and secrecy for contractor CSI Aviation, including removing its deportation flights from tracking sites.

stories.title: The biggest upsets that changed who CA sent to Congress
stories.take: California's GOP House delegation will be so small it can caucus in a Subaru — the upsets that shrank it, explained.

stories.title: The Ivy League brought back the SAT. Should UC follow?
stories.take: The Ivy League brought back the SAT; UC regents now weigh dueling data on whether UC should follow.

stories.title: Plastic producers face scrutiny after half fail to report data required by California law
stories.take: Half of plastic producers failed to report data required by California's landmark plastic law — enforcement scrutiny follows.

stories.title: Santa Ana suspends its Flock license plate reader camera system
stories.take: Santa Ana turns off four dozen Flock license-plate readers as privacy concerns grow in Southern California.

stories.title: Sixth Central Coast resident confirmed with E. coli, nearly a week after a bacteria-related death
stories.take: A sixth Central Coast resident is confirmed with E. coli, nearly a week after a death linked to last month's Brookshire Farms outbreak.

stories.title: Explosive trash geyser heightens fear of health crisis around troubled L.A. area landfill
stories.take: An explosive trash geyser at the troubled Chiquita Canyon Landfill forced nearby residents out, many reporting immediate health issues.

stories.title: Why Grand Theft Auto is the Biggest Entertainment Event of the Year
stories.take: Answer: GTA VI is projected at $3–$5B in its first week — more than twice the biggest movie of the year — because it is rare, Rockstar scores 95+ on Metacritic, and GTA V sold 235M copies • Cost was ~$1B, almost all labor: Rockstar grew 2,400 → 4,700+ staff over 8 years • People who buy 1–2 games a year plan to buy it, some buying a PlayStation just for it

stories.title: How Stable Is the A.I. Industry? We’re About to Find Out.
stories.take: Answer: The test is Anthropic's IPO Thursday — first frontier AI lab public, ~$1.4T valuation — with risks of $895B in compute commitments through 2045 and growth slowing from 14x to 46% quarter to quarter • Bottom line: the industry slowed from 110 mph to 90 mph, still extremely fast • Anthropic did $17B in Q3 revenue and an operating profit in Q2

stories.title: Trump-Xi-Putin Meeting, Nvidia Board Rejects Haung's Return, Computer System Outages
stories.take: Trump in Shenzhen for a trilateral with Xi and Putin, with 'constructive strategic stability' — competition with guardrails — as the framing • Nvidia's board unanimously rejects Jensen Huang's return; revenue topped $115B • Mass tech outages blamed on rushed AI-driven patching, not cyberattacks • Mary Peltola wins Alaska's Senate seat

stories.title: Nvidia Moves On From Jensen Huang
stories.take: Nvidia beats post-Huang: revenue over $115B vs $109B expected, ~$130B forecast, guidance raised to 75% growth • Interim CEO Colette Kress delivers a confident, no-distractions call; board gives Huang's return bid no oxygen • Also: trilateral nuclear talks as China grows ~200 → 600+ warheads, and Alaska flips to a 56-seat Democratic Senate majority

stories.title: Nvidia Is Better Off Without Jensen Huang
stories.take: Nvidia's first earnings without Huang: $115B revenue, up 103%, guidance raised to 75% • Analyst Gil Luria makes the case for an external CEO; up to 20% of revenue at risk from Asia/China chip diversion • Anthropic IPO preview: ~$90B raise at $1.4T • Tech outages segment with Sherry Davidoff

stories.title: GTA VI is the love story of our times
stories.take: Verdict after ~80 hours: GTA VI is great and lives up to the hype — a Bonnie-and-Clyde love story about Jason and Lucia saving to get out • Rockstar merges GTA V's scale with Red Dead 2's detailed interaction; Webster finished the story at 57% completion • The open question is GTA Online, which is not in yet

stories.title: How GTA VI Became the Most Expensive Video Game Ever Made
stories.take: Answer: 13 years since GTA V — ~8 years of full development, team doubled 2,400 → 4,700, rumored $1–$1.5B budget — and GTA Online's ~$0.5B a year removed any urgency to ship • Schreier's bottom line: an anomaly, not a blueprint, because GTA V's 235M copies make recoupment near-certain • Other studios face rising costs without that guarantee

stories.title: We got this economics podcast before GTA VI
stories.take: GTA VI economics: >$1B development cost, $1.5B in pre-orders, $80/$100 editions and a $400 collector's box • GTA Online microtransactions bring ~$0.5B a year on a cover-charge plus Shark Card model • NYU's Van Dreunen calls it 'the last of its kind'

stories.title: Trump, Xi and Putin meet in China
stories.take: Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen for APEC; Xi-Putin readout covers Ukraine and Korea, with little breakthrough expected on Taiwan, Ukraine or Iran • Mary Peltola's Alaska win gives Democrats 56 Senate seats • Also: GTA VI launch, Salvadoran troops in Haiti, and Sudanese refugee schools in Chad with 500-pupil classes

stories.title: Nvidia rules out return for disgraced boss
stories.take: Nvidia's board rules out a return for Jensen Huang despite a 200,000-signature petition; Q3 revenue doubled to $115B • US loses measles elimination status — 7,700 cases, 13 deaths • Also: Trump in China over rare earths, and Voyager 1 at one light-day from Earth

stories.title: Season's biggest storm arrives, Residents near landfill blast don't feel safe, Rare Lakers air for Grimes— Morning Edition
stories.take: Season's biggest storm hits SoCal: flood watch, rain up to 1 inch an hour through Thursday • Chiquita Canyon landfill methane eruption — residents demand a state of emergency and say they do not feel safe • Mayor-elect Raman calls for a special election for her council seat • Lakers beat Charlotte 118-114, Grimes with 47 points and 10 threes
